evidence.title: Black Hills plans $1.8 billion investment to power Google's data center

occurrences.checkable_against: Black Hills Corp announcement or executed power supply agreements for Google's Cheyenne data center
occurrences.quote_span: Black Hills Corp (BKH.N) said on Tuesday it signed agreements to power a proposed Google data center in Cheyenne, Wyoming
occurrences.speaker: Black Hills Corp
occurrences.subject: Black Hills power supply and generation investment for Google's Cheyenne data center

occurrences.checkable_against: Black Hills resource mix and reserve-margin planning documents for the Cheyenne project

occurrences.subject: Black Hills power supply and generation investment for Google's Cheyenne data center
